 "description": "SLSQ128R18 As part of our accelerating growth, Databricks is looking for a dynamic Digital Native Account Executive to join our team in Seoul, Korea. Execute a land-and-expand strategy by driving platform consumption, identifying new high-impact data use cases, and steering renewals/upsells within won accounts. Orchestrate internal technical resources (Solutions Architects, Customer Success) and cloud ecosystem partners (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) to maximize sales velocity and customer value. Exceed individual activity, pipeline generation, and annual revenue targets while building a scalable territory plan. What we look for: 5+ years of software/cloud sales experience selling enterprise software, SaaS, or consumption-based PaaS solutions to the Korean market, with an emphasis on digital native/tech sector accounts. Proven track record of exceeding quota in complex sales cycles, selling data, analytics, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML platforms. Strong command of structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Value Selling, Command of the Message). Deep understanding of the Digital Native buying process, modern engineering mindsets, and developer/architect evaluation criteria. Demonstrated ability to navigate consumption/usage-based business models and partner co-selling strategies.
